profile.summary: College Track is a nonprofit college completion program for first-generation students from under-resourced communities. It supports students for about ten years, from ninth grade through college graduation and into their careers, with academic, financial and personal support. It operates in 13 communities across the United States and is headquartered in Oakland, California.
